column2: Genotype PCA of the cohort; on a tight panel few on-target sites give weak structure — real ancestry assignment uses somalier with the 1000G-labelled reference (off-target sites).
Fraction of callset variants that actually received each annotation (proof the annotation landed, not silently missed on a contig-name mismatch).
Per-gene burden significance (-log10 p) with a Bonferroni line; collapses rare+functional variants per gene. Validity depends on N, phenotype definition, ancestry matching.
QQ plot of gene-burden p-values vs uniform expectation; lambda = genomic inflation. Small-N synthetic results prove the machinery only — not valid association.
CNV-target genes coloured by CaptureForge callability: green=depth-callable, red=breakpoint-blind (low-confidence, e.g. CR1/CFH).
Number of non-neutral copy-number calls per sample.
Per-target log2 copy ratio per sample; deviations from 0 indicate copy-number change.
Distribution of per-sample mean target depth across the cohort vs the gate threshold.
Declared vs somalier-inferred sex per sample (somalier infers from X/Y signal incl. off-target reads — the backstop for an autosomal panel with no X/Y targets).
Most-severe VEP consequence per variant across the callset.
VerifyBamID2 FREEMIX contamination estimate per sample vs threshold (grey note if no SVD panel available).
Fraction of target bases covered at >= each depth, per sample (sensitivity for calling).
FOLD_80_BASE_PENALTY: fold extra sequencing for 80% of targets to reach the mean (1.0 = perfectly uniform).
Per-site total depth (INFO/DP) distribution across the joint callset.
Library duplication rate per sample (coordinate dedup; lower is better).
Variant counts before and after GATK hard-filtering, by type (sites retained).
Fraction of called variants passing the GATK hard-filters, by type and overall.
Number of sites rejected by each hard-filter criterion (which filter removed what).
hap.py F1 per variant type vs GIAB truth, restricted to the panel BED (on-target).
hap.py precision & recall vs GIAB truth, restricted to the panel BED (on-target) (on-target). Synthetic test only proves the machinery; real numbers need a GIAB control + truth v4.2.1.
Distribution of gnomAD African-ancestry allele frequencies; title shows the % of variants carrying an AFR AF (key for rare-variant filtering / burden).
Heterozygous-to-homozygous-alt ratio per sample; extreme values flag sample-quality issues.
Raw paired-end read count per sample from the input FASTQs (sequencing yield).
Fragment insert-size distribution per sample (library size; capture efficiency).
Percent of reads mapped and properly paired per sample (alignment success).
Per-sample fraction of no-call genotypes in the joint callset (sample quality).
Variants with a dbSNP rsID (known) vs without (novel) — novelty rate.
Fold-enrichment of on-target vs genome-average coverage (capture performance).
Percent of bases on the capture target per sample (capture specificity).
Variants in each paralog-ambiguous gene region, split into confident (uniquely callable, high MQ) vs flagged low-confidence (multimapping-ambiguous, low MQ).
Mean coverage depth per target gene per sample; spot under-covered genes (e.g. CR1/CFH).
PhyloP conservation-score distribution; positive = conserved (likely functional).
Per-sample QC checks (green=pass, red=fail, grey=not assessed); sample label shows the gate decision. Quarantined samples are kept and reported, not dropped.
Variant-site QUAL distribution, PASS vs hard-filtered (call confidence).
Pairwise somalier relatedness; synthetic test samples are near-identical so values run high (machinery proven) — a real cohort shows true relatedness structure.
Annotation/known-sites resources discovered locally; orange = present but needs indexing/build check, red = missing (stage will skip gracefully).
Declared vs inferred sex per sample (grey note if the panel has no X/Y targets to infer from).
Distribution of genotyped repeat-unit counts (allele sizes) per STR locus.
Fraction of samples successfully genotyped at each STR locus (call rate).
Spanning-read support per sample at each STR locus (genotype confidence).
Transition/transversion ratio per sample; whole-exome ~3.0, smaller panels vary (calling quality).
Per-sample count of non-reference genotypes in the joint callset (calling yield).
